about: For the lab only; never reaches a session. Planted problem, kind p03 (Two parts of a chart in colours a person would call the same): see research/user-lab/planted.md.

plants.problem: Two different fees in the cost bars and their legend are two shades of the same orange, so the reader cannot tell which part of a bar is which fee.
plants.where: the cost bars under the result and their legend
plants.counts: A finding that two (or more) colours in the cost bars or legend look the same or too alike to tell apart.
plants.notCounts: A complaint that there are too many colours, or that the legend is hard to read, without saying two look alike.
